title: Synthetic water damage rule pack
provenance: Invented for this repository. The line codes are generic and made up. They are not Xactimate codes and this is not any carrier's rule set. The rules are modelled loosely on publicly documented water damage remediation practice (extract, remove wet material, treat, dry, monitor, rebuild) and the numeric constants below were chosen to make the demonstration legible, not from field data. Real packs are carrier specific, negotiated, and proprietary. Treat every rule here as a placeholder for one a restoration contractor would give you.

MIT-AIRMOVER-DAY.label: Air mover, per unit per day
MIT-AIRMOVER-DAY.note: Unit count is derived from affected floor area over sf_per_airmover. Real placement also counts wall and ceiling surfaces and the drying class. The constant is invented.

MIT-DEHU-DAY.label: Dehumidifier, per unit per day
MIT-DEHU-DAY.note: Unit count is derived from affected volume over cuft_per_dehumidifier. Real sizing depends on equipment class and grains of moisture. The constant is invented.

MIT-AFD-DAY.label: Air filtration device, per unit per day
MIT-AFD-DAY.note: No quantity basis. Device count depends on containment layout, which this pack does not model.

DEMO-FLR-LAM.label: Laminate or wood floor removal and disposal

RBD-FLR-LAM.label: Laminate floor install
RBD-FLR-LAM.note: Basis is the full floor area of the room, not the affected area, because flooring is normally replaced wall to wall. This pack carries no waste factor allowance. See README limitations.

RBD-FLR-CPT.label: Carpet install
RBD-FLR-CPT.note: This pack carries no waste factor allowance. See README limitations.

GEN-DEBRIS-HAUL.label: Debris haul and disposal
GEN-DEBRIS-HAUL.note: No quantity basis. Load count depends on material volume and dump access, which this pack does not model.

GEN-PPE-DAY.label: Personal protective equipment and consumables, per day

GEN-CONTAIN-BARRIER.label: Containment barrier, temporary
GEN-CONTAIN-BARRIER.note: No quantity basis. Barrier area depends on opening geometry, which this pack does not capture. Quantity on this code is never checked, which is a known blind spot.

evidence_rules.title: Billed line with no documentation covering its area
evidence_rules.reason: The line is billed against an area that has no photo, note, scan or moisture reading attached to it at all.

evidence_rules.title: Billed line with area documentation but nothing matching the code requirement
evidence_rules.reason: The area is documented, but nothing in it matches what the rule pack asks for on this code. Field tagging is unreliable, so this is flagged for review rather than treated as settled.
evidence_rules.note: This is the rule most likely to be wrong in the field. See NOTES.md question 6.

quantity_rules.title: Quantity contradicts the measurement basis for the code
quantity_rules.reason: Billed quantity is outside the tolerance band around the basis this rule pack assigns to the code.

quantity_rules.title: Unit of measure does not match the code
quantity_rules.reason: The line is billed in a unit the rule pack does not use for this code.

duplicate_rules.title: Same code billed twice in the same area
duplicate_rules.reason: Two line items carry the same code against the same area.

duplicate_rules.title: Two codes from one exclusive group billed in the same area
duplicate_rules.reason: Two line items in the same exclusivity group bill the same physical work in one area.

sequence_rules.title: Drywall replacement without a drywall removal
sequence_rules.reason: New drywall is billed in this area but no drywall removal is billed for it.

sequence_rules.title: Finish paint over new drywall without a sealer or primer
sequence_rules.reason: Finish paint is billed over newly hung drywall in this area with no sealer or primer line.

sequence_rules.title: Finish paint on existing wall without a sealer or primer
sequence_rules.reason: Finish paint is billed with no sealer or primer line. On a sound existing surface that can be correct, so this is raised for review rather than as an error.

sequence_rules.title: Floor covering installed without a floor covering removal
sequence_rules.reason: New floor covering is billed in this area but no floor covering removal is billed for it.

sequence_rules.title: Baseboard installed without a baseboard removal
sequence_rules.reason: New baseboard is billed in this area but no baseboard removal is billed for it.

sequence_rules.title: Insulation removal without opening the wall
sequence_rules.reason: Wet insulation removal is billed in this area but no drywall removal is billed to open the cavity.

required_rules.title: Area scoped for extraction with no extraction line
required_rules.reason: The area scope records water to be extracted and no extraction line is billed for it.

required_rules.title: Category 2 or 3 loss with material removal and no antimicrobial
required_rules.reason: This pack pairs a category 2 or higher loss that required material removal with an antimicrobial application in the same area.

required_rules.title: Structural drying with no dehumidification
required_rules.reason: The job is classed for structural drying and no dehumidifier line is billed.

required_rules.title: Drying equipment with no monitoring visits
required_rules.reason: Equipment days are billed with no monitoring visit line. This pack expects the readings that justify the equipment days to be billed alongside them.

required_rules.title: Material removal with no debris disposal
required_rules.reason: Material was removed and no debris haul or disposal line is billed. This is money the contractor spent and did not bill.

required_rules.title: Carpet removed without the pad under it
required_rules.reason: Carpet removal is billed in this area with no pad removal. Pad under wet carpet is normally removed with it and is commonly missed on the estimate.

required_rules.title: Drywall removed on a rebuild job with no drywall replacement
required_rules.reason: This job carries rebuild scope and drywall was removed in this area with nothing billed to put it back.

required_rules.title: Baseboard removed on a rebuild job with no baseboard replacement
required_rules.reason: This job carries rebuild scope and baseboard was removed in this area with nothing billed to put it back.

required_rules.title: Category 3 loss with no protective equipment line
required_rules.reason: A category 3 loss is billed with no protective equipment or consumables line.

required_rules.title: Floor covering removed on a rebuild job with no replacement
required_rules.reason: This job carries rebuild scope and floor covering was removed in this area with nothing billed to replace it.

required_rules.title: Rebuild scope with no final cleaning
required_rules.reason: Rebuild work is billed with no final cleaning line.

documentation_rules.title: Area in scope with no documentation of any kind
documentation_rules.reason: This area carries scope, measurements or billed lines and has no photo, note, scan or moisture reading attached to it.
